global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers (--context), the platform's then the higher levels', never an instance's.

forgejoUrl.title: Forgejo URL
forgejoUrl.description: URL the runner reaches Forgejo at (its Actions API), also the jobs' GITHUB_SERVER_URL. The default is the sandbox's Forgejo Service (component 20-forgejo).

registrationSecret.title: Registration secret
registrationSecret.description: Secret of the release namespace holding the offline registration secret of the runner: 40 hexadecimal characters, the --secret given to forgejo forgejo-cli actions register on the Forgejo side.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: The topology file of okdp-gitops, YAML text: the git repositories of the platform, of the projects and of the output of the deployments layout. Mounted at /etc/okdp/gitops/topology.yaml.

credentialsSecret.title: Git credentials Secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret of the release namespace with the git credentials of okdp-gitops (keys username and password, or bearerToken), allowed to push to the output repository. Mounted at /etc/okdp/gitops/credentials (GITOPS_CREDENTIALS_DIR).

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: Jobs the runner runs at once. Every compile pushes to the output repository: above 1, two compiles can race and one push be refused.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Resources of the runner container, where the jobs (okdp-gitops compile) run (requests/limits).

image.title: Runner image
image.description: Image of the runner (forgejo-runner, bash, sh): the jobs run in its container.

okdpGitopsImage.title: okdp-gitops image
okdpGitopsImage.description: Image the okdp-gitops binary is copied from (/usr/local/bin/okdp-gitops, a static binary): an init container puts it on the jobs' PATH.
